subject: VaultMed onboarding credit request — VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@vaultmed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@vaultmed.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding credit to meet Q3 budget window

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the throughput and the observability features. We are prepared to move forward and sign an annual commitment for $1.2M, but we have a constraint: our Q3 procurement cycle requires a material first-quarter credit to make the budget work.

Ask: a one-time onboarding credit of 40% applied to the first quarter invoice (approx $120k). If Redwood can confirm this before our procurement deadline (end of next week), we will countersign the term sheet and route to legal.

I understand this is outside standard policy; happy to take a phone call. Attach: draft term sheet for reference.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Procurement | VaultMed
Elena.Soto@vaultmed.com
Attachment: vaultmed-term-sheet.pdf (stub)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding credit to meet Q3 budget window — recommend review + numbers

Looping you in — VaultMed (DEAL-8732) is ready to sign an annual $1.2M commitment if we grant a 40% onboarding credit for the first quarter. They want confirmation before the end of next week.

Quick summary / economic impact:
- Total ARR: $1.2M annual commitment (committed).
- Requested credit: 40% of first-quarter invoice (~$120k).
- Proposed counter (my recommendation): 20% spot credit applied to first invoice, plus a true-up clause after month 3 tied to usage and SLA. Alternatively, allow a 25% capped credit only if contract is 12 months non-cancellable.
- Upside: faster close (likely within 10 business days), potential for expansion given a six-month POC to prod.
- Risk: sets a precedent for large spot credits; need exec clearance (Markus) for anything >20%.

Attachments: their term sheet (vaultmed-term-sheet.pdf). Also including a quick note with estimated P&L impact below.

Ask: Markus — can you sign off on a one-time 20% credit (or 25% conditional)? If not, advise next steps and any additional commercial guardrails (cap on credit, clawback language, renewal requirements).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding credit to meet Q3 budget window — recommend review + numbers

Thanks Vivek — reviewed the term sheet and ran a quick sensitivity.

My recommendation: approve a one-time 25% onboarding credit, but structure it as a capped credit memo applied to the first invoice (not an open-ended rebate). Conditions:
- 12-month committed term, prepaid or net-30 (no staged cancel).
- Credit capped at $150k absolute ceiling.
- Usage clause: if actual consumption in months 1–3 exceeds forecast by >20% we forfeit the remainder of the credit and invoice the delta at standard rates.
- No retroactive credits or credits applied to third-party charges (marketplaces excluded).

Rationale: 25% strikes a reasonable balance between closing velocity and revenue protection; it is higher than our normal authorization but manageable given the size of the deal and likelihood of expansion.

I've attached a short financial-impact workbook (financial-impact-vaultmed.xlsx) with ARR, gross margin, and cash timing assumptions.

If Markus is comfortable with the guardrails above, we can issue the credit memo and ask legal to slot the clauses into the SOW/term sheet.

—Marissa
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: financial-impact-vaultmed.xlsx (stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding credit to meet Q3 budget window — recommend review + numbers

Quick note: I support Marissa's recommendation (25% capped) with two operational requirements:
- Insert a 90-day ramp milestone into the SOW (if usage < 60% of forecast at day 90, credit is clawed back pro rata).
- Sales to add a single-use discount token; legal to ensure the credit cannot be ported to other deals.

If Markus signs off, sales will push the revised term sheet and request countersignature.

Jonas
VP, North America Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding credit to meet Q3 budget window — recommend review + numbers

Approved: 25% capped onboarding credit with the conditions outlined by Marissa and Jonas. Final notes:
- Credit memo to be issued by Finance and applied to the first invoice (no cash payout).
- 12-month firm term required; clause to include 90-day ramp milestone and pro rata clawback.
- No marketplace or third-party pass-throughs.
- Legal: include explicit non-transferability language.

Vivek — you have sign-off to return to VaultMed with the revised term sheet. Please attach the DocuSign link for signature and confirm they will not request additional retro credit.

Markus Klein
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
Attachment: vaultmed-signed-term-sheet.pdf (post-sign stub)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-8732
